verdict.rationale: Glama offers a multi-model chat app and an MCP gateway that handle user data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out or a no-training policy. The only related item, "Private by default" for hosted servers, controls directory listing visibility, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
